name: BuiltWith (API and web profiles)
tier_rationale: BuiltWith Pty Ltd is an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P073 records tier trusted and P083 cond 5 lists 'trusted - BuiltWith'.

reliability.justification: Commercial web-technology index: technology profiles and shared-id relationships come from BuiltWith's crawls and can lag the live site; relationship data follows the P061 shared-id and clone rules (P073 cond 5).

builtwith.description: BuiltWith API key (KEY= query parameter, masked by the central redactor AR01; free1 technology groups, v21/rv2 on paid credits)
builtwith.plan_hint: business = a company/team BuiltWith plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal before it runs under corporate (P073 cond 2); the free key returns technology groups only and Domain API lookups spend paid credits

api.title: BuiltWith API (free1 technology groups; v21 domain and rv2 relationships on paid credits)

terms.quote: Key-terms: a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal before it runs under corporate.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P073 cond 2); research C0157 terms 'BuiltWith terms' (status verified_needs_key 200) and C0156 'BuiltWith ToS'. Endpoints api.builtwith.com/free1/api.json?KEY=&LOOKUP= (technology groups), /v21/api.json?KEY=&LOOKUP=&HIDETEXT=yes&NOPII=yes and /rv2/api.json (relationships) on paid credits. KEY= travels in the URL: the module merges only after the central redaction (AR01, P073 cond 1); every call carries NOPII=yes and HIDETEXT=yes (P073 cond 3). Merge only with a trimmed real success fixture captured with the team key (P073 cond 6). Used by builtwith.

web_profiles.title: BuiltWith technology and relationship pages builtwith.com/{domain}, /relationships/... (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Free web UI; provider ToS apply (manual analyst use)

web_profiles.notes: Research C0188 terms (verified_live 200): builtwith.com/{domain}, /relationships/{domain} and /relationships/tag/{analytics_id}; the analytics_id relationship template stays verified=false until checked (P083 cond 8). Manual pivot links only (data/pivot_links/url_web.json and the analytics_ids reverse-lookup pivots, P061 cond 4); V3LUM never fetches them (P311). Used by pivots_url_web and analytics_ids.

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G03-1, p2-G14-1, p3-G03-1 (P061, P073, P083): batches only extend it (builtwith__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). api.builtwith.com serves the keyed API (P073); builtwith.com serves the manual technology and relationship pages (P061, P083). Quota: the free key answers about 1 request per second (research C0157, observed) -> key budget at 80% plus min_interval 1 s; Domain API credits are paid and get their own figures once the plan is recorded (P073 cond 2). ttl 7 days saves paid credits on repeated domains. No error markers yet: the owning batch adds the Errors[]-in-200 markers ('You need to login or create an account', credit messages; never EMPTY, P073 cond 4) with a trimmed real fixture.
